raw_text: A deepfake video of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy calling on his troops to surrender has been debunked by multiple digital forensics experts and officially denied by Ukrainian authorities. The video, which circulated on Telegram and social media, featured detectable AI manipulation artifacts including facial inconsistencies and audio desynchronization. Meta and YouTube removed copies of the video from their platforms within hours.
clean_text: Deepfake video of Zelenskyy calling for surrender debunked by forensics experts and denied by Ukrainian authorities. Video featured AI manipulation artifacts and was removed by platforms.
